name: Global Type Declarations
description: Ambient type declarations for the Cockpit IDE renderer context. Defines EditorState (open files, cursors, explorer width), WorkspaceState (plugins array, z-order, zoom, pan, lock), DirEntry, EditorSelectionState, and the full Window.electronAPI interface covering terminal, workspace, git, filesystem, clipboard, shell, prefs, and IDE method signatures.

types.name: EditorState
types.description: Describes open editor tabs, active file, explorer splitter width, and per-file cursor/scroll positions

types.name: WorkspaceState
types.description: Serializable canvas state: plugin positions/sizes/open-state, z-order, zoom, pan, and optional lock flag

types.name: DirEntry
types.description: Directory listing item with name and isDirectory flag

types.name: EditorSelectionState
types.description: Current editor selection: file path, selected text, and line/column ranges
